name: ModelVariant773_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant773_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (twelve orbs released in four timed batches from a model part streak across the field with trailing ribbons and flash on impact); for a non-negative request it selects the command record indexed by the request, seeds the twelve orb positions and velocities, clears the ribbons and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 while orbs are landing or close to the end, 1 once when the last orb has landed, 2 once the flash has finished and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-790 and 887 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
